name: Find the bug
description: Tap the buggy line (or lines) in a short listing. Graded by the exact line set, with partial credit; the fix and the reason appear afterwards.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: What the code is supposed to do.

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many lines the learner should pick.

fields.name: bugs
fields.description: Line numbers (1-based) of the bug, e.g. [8].

fields.name: fix
fields.description: Fixed lines: { "8": "    for i in range(k, len(xs)):" }.
